integrity: Self-contained proofs and two replayable standalone verification scripts; source date is the earliest verified day-resolution source for relevant excitable-media study, not a claim that the model originated in 1993.
scientific_limitations: Exact n>=5 synchronous three-state threshold-one Greenberg-Hastings dynamics on two deletion types only; no stochastic/higher-threshold or individual nonzero-orbit basin census. title: Two-edge fault geometry changes the complete excitation clock census on cliques
